definition.note: No closed form is stored for this surface. It is defined by its shipped implementation in math_art.minsurf.parametric, which is authoritative; an unverified transcription would silently define a different surface.

provenance.definition: Derived from the Math Art generator registries and cross-referenced to the literature; not transcribed from any gallery's compilation.
sources: H. Karcher, "Embedded minimal surfaces derived from Scherk's examples", Manuscripta Math. 62 (1988);

H. F. Scherk (1835); A. Enneper (1864); M. Weber, https://minimalsurfaces.blog/ (6-Ended Scherk g0; Alternating Fence of Half-Catenoids, 2024; Fence of Catenoids; Helicoidal Karcher-Scherk; Periodic Enneper; Enneper-Scherk; Translation-Invariant Torus with 1 Enneper and 3 Annular Ends, notebook by Ramazan Yol, 2024).

cross_checked.detail: 'The embedded singly periodic Scherk surfaces of genus 0' with six annular ends; embedded examples shown for end angles 30 and 89 degrees, 'increasing the angle to 90 and higher creates non-embedded surfaces'.
